videos.verdict: inconclusive (first hours); best first-hours start of the channel

findings: Shorts carry the channel: 76 % of 14-day views come from the Shorts feed, with loops (avg view 243 %). The two good Shorts (Oct 18-19) brought 9 of the ~10 subscribers gained.
Long videos get almost no distribution: 4-38 views each, no Browse/Home traffic at all; their few viewers come from Related and stay ~7 min (442 s).
Long videos 'Morning Prayer for Protection' (0.2 %) and 'Night Prayer for Healing' (1.4 %) lose viewers in the first seconds: the opening does not hold.
Bible series part 1 had the strongest first hours of any video (35 views, 17 % likes) - early, needs the 48 h check.
The Shorts-to-long funnel is weak: the prayer Shorts link to full prayers, yet those long videos sit at 4-38 views.
loop_defects: The market panel and daily_intel still mine the Christian-prayer niche, not Bible stories; their directives are written daily and nobody reads them.
No 48 h / 7 d verdict was ever recorded for our videos (SYSTEM.md 'Our videos'), and the daily report does not list the Bible episodes.
No step turns findings into a change in the next episode.
